subject: Aligning demo kickoff, security evidence handoff, and procurement intro
messages:
From: Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.com>
To: Tom Adams <tom.adams@oakmonthealth.com>
Cc: Katie Lewis <katie.lewis@oakmonthealth.com>
Date: Wed, 07 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Quick follow-up + proposed demo windows (Oakmont)

Tom — great to meet you and Katie earlier. Thanks for walking through the priorities for Oakmont’s care management workflows — the latency and cost sensitivity you described makes a lot of sense.

Recap / next steps I hear:
- Short product demo + platform Q&A (45–60m) focused on inference latency, SSO, and data handling
- Call with your security/procurement folks to review evidence and procurement path

Proposed demo windows (PT):
- Tue Apr 13, 10:00–11:00am
- Wed Apr 14, 2:00–3:00pm
- Thu Apr 15, 9:00–10:00am

If one of those works, I’ll lock it and bring Marissa (solutions) and Rishi (procurement lead) to handle SSO and commercial questions. Also looping in Mina from our security team to share the SOC2/readiness checklist before the session.

Quick ask for you: can you confirm whether procurement prefers to be on the demo or a separate procurement/contract review?

Thanks — looking forward to the next step.

—
Michael Grant
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
michael.grant@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0123
Redwood Inference

Attachments: none in this message
From: Tom Adams <tom.adams@oakmonthealth.com>
To: Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.com>
Cc: Katie Lewis <katie.lewis@oakmonthealth.com>, procurement@oakmonthealth.com
Date: Wed, 07 Apr 2027 09:35:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Quick follow-up + proposed demo windows (Oakmont)

Michael — thanks for the recap. Wed Apr 14 2pm PT works best for us. Katie and I will both be on the demo; procurement (procurement@oakmonthealth.com) should join the procurement/terms portion but it’s fine if they listen in to the product show-and-tell.

A few notes for the demo team:
- We will want to walk through SSO integration options (SAML + OIDC) and how you handle key management for private deployments.
- Preliminary questions from security: data retention defaults and audit log availability.

Katie — looping you for procurement availability and to ensure the right contacts are on the thread.

Tom Adams
Director, Clinical Platforms
Oakmont Health

Subject: Re: Quick follow-up + proposed demo windows (Oakmont)

Thanks Tom — locking Wed Apr 14, 2–3pm PT. Calendar invite to follow.

Marissa / Rishi / Mina — can you join the call? Here’s what the Oakmont asks are:
- Demo: focus on latency under constrained batches, private deployment options (VPC + on-prem), and cost controls (batching/quantization)
- SSO: show SAML/Okta path plus what logs we surface for audits
- Evidence: procurement wants SOC2 and a concise list of artifacts we can provide for their security review

Mina — can you attach the latest SOC2 snapshot and a short SSO readiness checklist for Oakmont? I’ll send the joint mutual action plan after my follow-up with Tom.

Marissa — can you lead the demo and include the mini runbook for the SSO demo steps? Rishi — once we have procurement contacts, can you set expectations for timelines and typical procurement checkpoints?

Thanks team.

—
Michael
From: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>
To: Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.com>, marissa.cole@redwood.com, rishi.malhotra@redwood.com
Cc: Tom Adams <tom.adams@oakmonthealth.com>, Katie Lewis <katie.lewis@oakmonthealth.com>
Date: Wed, 07 Apr 2027 11:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Aligning demo kickoff, security evidence handoff, and procurement intro

Hi all — attaching the requested artifacts for Oakmont’s review (stubs attached here):
- SOC2-report-2026.pdf (SOC2 Type II, control period Jan–Dec 2026)
- sso-readiness-checklist.xlsx (covers SAML metadata exchange, assertion lifetime, attribute maps, test accounts)

Short notes:
- For audit logs we expose API-level request logs, token traces, and per-request metadata for up to 90 days by default; extended retention is available as an add-on.
- KMS integrations: we support AWS KMS and customer HSM options for Private deployments; we can include certificate-level details in the follow-up package.

I will also include a two-page summary of data-handling commitments (encryption-in-flight/at-rest, retention options, and access controls) ahead of the demo.

—
Mina Haddad
Security & Compliance Manager, Redwood Inference
mina.haddad@redwood.com

Attachments: SOC2-report-2026.pdf (attachment stub), sso-readiness-checklist.xlsx (attachment stub)

Tom / Katie — confirmed for Wed Apr 14, 2–3pm PT. I’ll run a 30–35 minute demo (system architecture, latency profiling, and SSO demo) and leave 20–25 minutes for Q&A (security and procurement).

Prep items for Oakmont (short):
- If you can share an Okta test tenant or SAML metadata file ahead of time, we’ll script the SSO demo and reduce iteration during the session.
- If procurement wants contract redline expectations or a template, Rishi can share our standard PoC terms during the call.

I’ll circulate a brief mutual-action-plan doc tomorrow outlining owners and dates. Looking forward to it.

—
Marissa Cole
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com

Date: Sat, 10 Apr 2027 16:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Oakmont procurement — questions on PoC terms and data handling

Hello Rishi / Michael — thanks for including procurement on the thread. A couple of quick items we want clarified before the PoC: 
1) Are we able to receive a short form agreement (SFA) for a 30-day PoC with standard data protection clauses?
2) Will any PHI be processed during the PoC, and if so, do you have a BA agreement template?
3) Estimated lead time for a dedicated environment (if we choose a private deployment) — ballpark in days.

If you can reply with a short note and any template links we can review ahead of the call on Wed.

Thanks — procurement@oakmonthealth.com
